title: Unbounded positive constant generators with an attained divisor
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space whose compact opens are closed under binary intersections, $K,C$ abelian sheaves, $\iota:K\to C$ a monomorphism, and $C\simeq\underline{\mathbb Z}$ an isomorphism to the constant integer sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Assume $K$ admits an epimorphic presentation by a finite coproduct of extensions by zero of the constant integer sheaf on compact opens [def-sc-abelian-open-extension-by-zero]. Then there exist finitely many compact opens $A_i$, positive natural labels $c_i$, an epimorphism $g:\bigoplus_i j_{A_i!}\underline{\mathbb Z}\to K$, and sections $s_i\in K(A_i)$ such that the canonical unit of the ith summand maps to $s_i$ and $s_i$ maps to the constant section $c_i$ in $C(A_i)$. For every $x\in\bigcup_i A_i$ there is an active index $i$ such that $c_i$ divides every active label $c_j$. There is no prescribed upper bound on the labels and no stalk bound hypothesis. Empty families are allowed.

source.place: Lemma 0A38, first two proof paragraphs: clopen refinement, positive generators and adjoining gcds; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A38

proof.text: Extract the generating sections by evaluating the components of the finite epimorphism on the canonical unit. Under the constant-sheaf isomorphism their images are locally constant integer functions. On each compact open, split into the finitely many clopen fibres; the fibres are compact in X. Restrict the sections and their component maps. Drop zero fibres using injectivity of the inclusion, and negate negative sections and components. Stalkwise the positive family generates the same subgroup as the original family.

Adjoin the intersection of each nonempty subset of the positive family. Compactness follows by induction from binary intersection closure. Use integer Bezout coefficients to combine the restricted sections into a section with constant value the positive gcd. The constant-sheaf and extension-by-zero universal properties give its component map with the stated unit image. No empty intersection is used.

The original positive generators remain in the enlarged finite family. All added gcd sections are combinations of them. The resulting map therefore generates K on every stalk and is epi. At a point, the gcd of exactly the original active labels is one of the added active labels; it divides all original active labels and all gcd labels of subsets active at that point.

    (hgen : ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → Opens X)

      ∃ g : (∐ fun i => (abelianOpenExtensionByZero (U i)).obj

      (c : Fin n → ℕ), (∀ i, 0 < c i) ∧
      ∃ (g : (∐ fun i => (abelianOpenExtensionByZero (A i)).obj

        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) ⟶ K), Epi g ∧
        ∃ s : ∀ i, K.obj.obj (op (A i)),
          ( ∀ i,
      (Sigma.ι (fun j => (abelianOpenExtensionByZero (A j)).obj
        ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A j)))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) i ≫ g).hom.app
        (op (A i))
        (abelianOpenExtensionSection (A i)
          ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A i)))
            AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))) (A i) le_rfl
          ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A i)))
            ((Functor.const (Opens ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A i)))ᵒᵖ).obj
              (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))).app
            (op ((Opens.map (A i).inclusion').obj (A i))) (ULift.up 1))) = s i) ∧

      (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        ((Functor.const (Opens X)ᵒᵖ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))).app
